_comment: Per-model settings for llama.cpp, keyed by the served model's name (llama-server's model_alias, usually the GGUF filename). Copy the example to model_defaults.json (gitignored). logit_bias: applied under any explicit request/rhizome values, recorded in each node's sampling_params. bos_tokens: how many <|begin_of_text|> the model should see (default 1, standard Llama 3); the node records the effective prompt when it differs from the rendered template. Sun 1.0.1: +ln 386 on eot restores end-of-turn mass her untrained eot row shared with 385 twins; bos_tokens 2 because her SFT text began with <|begin_of_text|> and the trainer (TRL 0.8.6) added another.
